pain_point: Want to stop dead money going to rent - Rent is dead money. I could be paying off my own warehouse for the same monthly cost.
headline_outcome: Put That Rent Into Your Asset
primary_text: "Rent is dead money." Let's put a number on it. At $4,000 a month, you'll spend $240,000 over five years on rent. In ten years, $480,000. What do you own at the end? Nothing. Now imagine redirecting that money into a brand-new Truganina warehouse. In ten years, you could own it outright — or have significant equity in a property that's also grown in value. These off-the-plan warehouses are priced for small business owner-occupiers. Princes Freeway access, high clearance, flexible layouts. Same monthly output, completely different outcome. Get the price list and do the comparison yourself.
description: Redirect up to $480,000 in rent over 10 years into your own asset
